name: Kobold Trapper

items.name: Crossbow
items.description: This ranged weapon has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame called a tiller. The tiller has a mechanism to lock the bowstring in place, attached to a trigger mechanism that releases the tension and launches a bolt.

items.name: Light Hammer
items.description: This smaller version of the warhammer has a wooden or metal shaft ending in a metal head. Unlike its heavier cousin, it is light enough to throw.

items.name: Leather Armor
items.description: A mix of flexible and molded boiled leather, a suit of this type of armor provides some protection with maximum flexibility.

items.name: Formula Book (Containing formulas for three 1st- or 2nd-level snares)
items.description: A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from Pathfinder Player Core; characters of the alchemist class typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

generalAbilities.name: Booby-Trapped
generalAbilities.description:
A kobold trapper protects items in their backpack with a booby trap. This booby trap requires a successful Basic DC 18 Perception check to notice, and two successful Basic DC 15 Thievery checks to disable.

Accessing the backpack without disabling the trap destroys its contents, and splinters explode in a 10ft Type:burst centered on the backpack, dealing 3d6 Piercing Damage damage (Basic DC 15 Reflex Saving Throw save).

savenote: +1 circumstance to all defenses vs. traps

defensiveAbilities.name: +1 Circumstance to All Defenses vs. Traps

offensiveAbilities.name: Construct Trap
offensiveAbilities.description:
The kobold trapper creates a rudimentary trap on a surface in an adjacent square. The trap activates the next time a creature moves adjacent to it. The creature takes 2d6 2d6 Bludgeoning Damage{bludgeoning}, 2d6 Piercing Damage{piercing}, or 2d6 Slashing Damage{slashing} damage (determined by the trapper when the trap is constructed) with a Basic DC 18 Reflex Saving Throw save. On a failure, the creature also takes a –5 status penalty to all Speeds for 1 minute. The trap is destroyed when activated or after 8 hours, whichever comes first. A trapper typically carries enough raw materials to make six traps each day.

Effect: Construct Trap
